landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Transform Your Contracting Business?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of contractors who are closing more deals and saving time with ContractorOps AI
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: ContractorOps AI provides a complete toolkit to grow your contracting business 10x faster without having to work 10x harder.
landing.pricingWebsite: Professional modern Website for your business + maintenance
landing.phoneBubble1: Hi, I saw your missed call and listened to your voicemail. Sounds like an HVAC tune-up issue. Common causes include dirty filters, refrigerant leaks, or thermostat problems. I can come take a look. Did I miss anything? Feel free to upload photos/videos here:
landing.phoneBubble3: Got it. You can book your appointment here:
landing.phoneBubble4: Thanks — see you tomorrow at 1 PM. Let me know if you need to cancel by call or text.
landing.step1Body: Never miss a client. AI listens to calls, reads texts, and automatically follows up with personalized responses. It's text-based with no app downloads—clients use their built-in Messages; you capture every lead opportunity.
landing.step2ProjectDesc: Backyard landscaping for Sarah Johnson. Need to install 1,200 sq ft of premium sod, build a 10x12 paver patio with natural stone, and plant 3 shade trees (oak or maple). Include soil prep and grading.
landing.step2DescribeBody: Provide your project description and images. Our AI understands your requirements and prepares a comprehensive estimate based on your inputs.
landing.step3Body: AI analyzes your project description and instantly generates a competitive quote based on local market data.
landing.step4Body: AI recommends the best products for your project needs with real-time pricing and availability.
landing.step5ReplyPrompt: Reply YES to add to your calendar, or NO to skip.
landing.step5MeetingScheduled: Meeting scheduled with Customer on 2026-01-20 at 1:00 PM!
landing.step5CalendarLinkSent: Calendar link automatically sent to customer to book based on your availability
landing.step5Body: AI automatically detects scheduling conversations in your SMS and helps book meetings instantly. Customers receive a calendar link to select times based on your availability—no back-and-forth needed.
landing.featuresSectionTitle: Everything You Need to Scale Your Business
landing.featuresSectionSubtitle: Powerful AI-driven tools that automate estimates, follow-ups, product selection, and project management.
landing.featuresInvoiceBody: Describe your project and upload photos, and our AI generates accurate invoices with material lists and labor estimates in seconds.
landing.featuresCallsBody: Capture every lead: AI transcribes calls and texts, generates responses, and offers scheduling links so you never miss an opportunity.
landing.featuresProductsBody: Get job-specific product recommendations with pricing and availability from major retailers so you can order with confidence.
landing.featuresPmBody: Keep projects on track with task lists, assignees, due dates and simple reporting, built to work with your estimates.
landing.invoiceTermsText: Net 30 days. Late payments subject to 1.5% monthly interest.
landing.leadCaptureCallContent: Hi, I need some landscaping work done for my backyard. About 500 sq ft of mulch and new edging.
landing.leadCaptureAnalysis: Lead captured: Landscaping project, 500 sq ft mulch + edging
landing.leadCaptureAiMessage: Hi Sarah! Thanks for reaching out. I'd love to help with your backyard project. I can schedule a free estimate this week—how about Thursday at 2 PM?
landing.leadCaptureSarahReply: Thursday at 2 works perfect! See you then.
